architecture:
## Android architecture — System surfaces + shell

### Packages (all under `android/app/src/main/java/com/levi/pocketdj/`)

```
PocketDjApplication.kt            Application subclass: builds AppGraph, installs ProcessLifecycleOwner observer, WorkManager init
shell/
  ShellActions.kt                 the IntentServices analogue — ONE façade every out-of-UI surface calls (Auto, widgets, shortcuts, deep links, Assistant)
  NavRequestBus.kt                pending navigation route (atomic take) + routeMessage ("Can't open that")
  ShellRoute.kt                   sealed routes: Album/Artist/Playlist/Pocket/Setlist/SourcePlaylist/JukeboxJoin/BrowseSearch(query)/Tab
  LastSectionStore.kt             lastSection + History-default landing
  DeepLinkParser.kt               URL → DeepLink (JukeboxJoin | Mwf | CollectionFile | DiagKey | None); precedence identical to PocketDJApp.onOpenURL
  FlushRegistry.kt                background flush funnel (registered closures, run on ON_STOP)
onboarding/
  OnboardingStore.kt              marker doc {version,state,stage,completedAtMs} in DataStore key `pdj.onboarding.v1`; decide(); waitUntilComplete()
  OnboardingScreen.kt + 3 stage composables
work/
  WorkScheduler.kt                PeriodicWorkRequest ids: rip-reconcile (15 min, network), storage-prune (24 h), burn-drain (seam)
  RipReconcileWorker.kt, StoragePruneWorker.kt (CoroutineWorker; call AppGraph lazies)
playback/ (modifies existing)
  PlaybackService.kt → MediaLibraryService (AUTO-1); SessionPlayerArbiter.kt (LOCK-1); TransportOwner.kt (interface for Mix facade)
  resumption/ResumptionProvider.kt seam (held last queue, never auto-play)
widget/
  NowPlayingSnapshot.kt (kotlinx.serialization; iOS key names), WidgetSync.kt (observer → DataStore + cover PNG), NowPlayingWidget.kt (Glance), NowPlayingWidgetReceiver.kt, WidgetActionReceiver.kt, PendingWidgetCommands.kt
auto/
  AutoBrowseTree.kt               pure Kotlin: root/tabs/items → MediaItem list (unit-testable, no Android Auto import — the CarPlayModel doctrine)
  AutoLibraryCallback.kt          MediaLibrarySession.Callback: onGetLibraryRoot/onGetChildren/onGetItem/onSearch/onSetMediaItems/onCustomCommand
  AutoArtwork.kt                  artworkUri resolution (https catalog art; Coil-cached content URI fallback)
assistant/
  ShortcutsPublisher.kt           static shortcuts.xml + dynamic shortcuts (donation analogue, debounced on CollectionsStore change)
  MediaSearchHandler.kt           MEDIA_PLAY_FROM_SEARCH + session search → ShellActions
data/jukebox/ (extends existing)
  JukeboxLink.kt, JukeboxGuestState.kt, JukeboxGuestClient.kt (guestState/submitGuestRequest/listSessions/sessionInfo), JoinedSessionsStore.kt
screens/jukebox/JukeboxJoinScreen.kt, JoinedSessionsStrip.kt
screens/settings/
  SettingsSections.kt             section registry (List<SettingsSection>) — other areas append rows here, not inside SettingsScreen.kt
  ProfileSection.kt, ResetSection.kt, BackupSection.kt, DebugScreen.kt
data/backup/BackupZip.kt, CollectionFile.kt (PocketZip/PlaylistZip shape)
```

### Key classes and data flow

**ShellActions** (app-scoped, in `AppGraph`): `playPlaylist(id, shuffle)`, `playPocket(id, shuffle)`, `playSong(id)`, `playAlbum(id, shuffle)`, `playSongIds(ids, name, shuffle, context)`, `startAutoMix(source, shuffle)` / `pauseAutoMix()` / `resumeAutoMix()` (delegate to a `MixFacade?` seam — null until the Mix area lands ⇒ throws `NotAvailable`), `open(route)` (posts to NavRequestBus), `search(query)`. Every mutating call runs `onboarding.vetoIfIncomplete()` (iOS R4 veto) and `ensureReady()` = `catalogRepository.loadIfNeeded()` (returns after disk-cache seed; refresh continues in background — the Siri-budget doctrine). Playback goes through the existing `PlaybackController` / `QueuePlan` so Auto, widgets, shortcuts and the phone share one queue and one Now Playing.

**NavRequestBus**: `MutableStateFlow<ShellRoute?>`; the shell (`PocketDjApp`) collects it, `take()`s atomically (clear first), switches tab now, and stages the push after the tab-switch frame (`withFrameNanos`/`delay(450)`), exactly RootView's discipline. A route that cannot resolve (deleted collection, album not in catalog) sets `routeMessage` → app snackbar/alert — never a silent no-op.

**Lifecycle**: `PocketDjApplication` registers a `DefaultLifecycleObserver` on `ProcessLifecycleOwner`: `onStart` → `refreshEndpoints()`, `PendingWidgetCommands.drain()`, `WorkScheduler.ensureScheduled()`, `jukeboxRepository.bootstrap()`; `onStop` → `FlushRegistry.flushAll()` (BrowseSession debounce, collections `flushNow`, jukebox session, playback-session snapshot once that exists) then `WorkScheduler.ensureScheduled()`. WorkManager replaces BGTaskScheduler: rip-reconcile = `ripsRepository.refresh()`; storage-prune = `storageService.pruneIfDue()` (gate inside; no-op without cap — the storage area owns the gate). `android:foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback"` already covers audio.

**Lock-screen / MediaSession** (LOCK-1): one `MediaSession` (becomes `MediaLibrarySession` in AUTO-1). `SessionPlayerArbiter` holds the active `Player` and swaps it with `mediaSession.player = …` — rule: the engine that last STARTED audio owns the session; a restored-but-never-sounded engine is not a remote target; `preferred` owner answers remote commands after a restore. `TransportOwner` interface (`remotePlay/remotePause/remoteNext/remotePrev`, `supportsLike`, `setRunning`) is what the Mix facade must implement later; Mix's ⏭=fast switch / ⏮=slow switch semantics live in that implementation. A `ForwardingPlayer` over ExoPlayer gates `COMMAND_SEEK_TO_NEXT/PREVIOUS_MEDIA_ITEM` and `COMMAND_SET_REPEAT_MODE/SET_SHUFFLE_MODE` availability to "a set is running" (queue from a collection context, `mediaItemCount > 1`). Custom layout: ♥ `CommandButton` (SessionCommand `pdj.favorite`) shown only when a `FavoriteSeam` is wired (Collections area), hidden on the Mix owner. `onPlaybackResumption` returns the held queue + start position from `ResumptionProvider` with `playWhenReady=false` semantics honoured by never calling `play()` on connect (the CarPlay 'held, driver taps ▶' rule).

**Widgets** (WID-1): `WidgetSync` collects `playbackController.nowPlaying` + queue tail (via the controller's MediaController hop) + favorite state → writes `NowPlayingSnapshot` JSON (same keys as `apple/Shared/NowPlayingSnapshot.swift`: isPlaying, hasContent, title, artist, songId, coverVersion, upNext[{id,songId,title,artist}], isFavorite, appleMusicId, repeatMode, shuffleEnabled, recVerdict, recScope) to `filesDir/widget/nowplaying.json` + `cover.png`, then `NowPlayingWidget().updateAll()`. Glance renders Responsive sizes (small ≈ 2×1: toggle+next; medium: ⏮⏯⏭♥; large: + repeat/shuffle + Up Next). Transport actions send `ACTION_MEDIA_BUTTON` KeyEvents to `PlaybackService` (works when the process is dead: service starts, Media3 resumption). ♥/repeat/shuffle go to `WidgetActionReceiver`: if the graph is live apply immediately, else append to `pendingWidgetCommands` (DataStore JSON; cap 32; transport entries expire after 20 s, verdicts/favorites never) and drain at `onStart`. A ♥ queued while quit carries the snapshot's `songId` so it targets the song the user saw.

**Android Auto** (AUTO-1): `PlaybackService` becomes `MediaLibraryService`; manifest adds `android.media.browse.MediaBrowserService` intent filter + `com.google.android.gms.car.application` meta-data (`res/xml/automotive_app_desc.xml`, `<uses name="media"/>`). `AutoBrowseTree` is pure Kotlin over `CollectionsStore` + `CatalogRepository` + `RipsRepository`: root children = `tab:playlists`, `tab:pockets` (CONTENT_STYLE list hints), later `tab:mix`; `tab:playlists` = user playlists + source playlists (`src:` ids, subtitle badge); collection node children = `all:<id>` ("Play all"), `shuffle:<id>`, then song items (playable, windowed 200, unplayable AM-only songs rendered non-playable with subtitle "Not available here"); `continue:` row first at root when `ResumptionProvider.held() != null`. Selecting a song calls `ShellActions.playSongIds(collection songs, startAt=song)` so Auto's queue = the collection. Custom browser action `pdj.addTo` ("Add to pocket/playlist") only on song items (Media3 1.6 `EXTRAS_KEY_CUSTOM_BROWSER_ACTION_*`; verify on DHU). Catalog not warm ⇒ root child "Loading…" and `notifyChildrenChanged(root)` when loaded (no catalog sweep on the connect path — the car never triggers heavy work).

**Assistant / shortcuts** (INT-1): `MainActivity` gets `android.media.action.MEDIA_PLAY_FROM_SEARCH`; `MediaSearchHandler.resolve(query, focus)` → collection name match (playlist/pocket, case-insensitive, then fuzzy via `JukeboxMatcher.normalize`) → `ShellActions`; same resolver serves `MediaLibrarySession.Callback.onSearch/onAddMediaItems(searchQuery)`. `ShortcutsPublisher` publishes static shortcuts (Start Jukebox, Open Collections, Open History) from `res/xml/shortcuts.xml` and dynamic shortcuts (`ShortcutManagerCompat.pushDynamicShortcut`, up to `maxShortcutCountPerActivity`) for the most recently played playlists/pockets with intents `pocketdj://play/playlist/<id>?shuffle=0`; debounced 1 s on `CollectionsStore.state` changes (the Spotlight-donation analogue). Deep links of the `pocketdj://play/...` form are parsed by `DeepLinkParser` and executed through `ShellActions`.

**Deep links** (LINK-1): manifest intent filters — `pocketdj` scheme (hosts `jukebox`, `mwf`, `play`), `https://jukebox.pocket-dj.com/*` with `android:autoVerify="true"`, `ACTION_VIEW`/`ACTION_SEND` for `application/x-pocketdj-collection`, `application/zip`, `*/*` with `.pdjcollection` path pattern. `MainActivity.onCreate`/`onNewIntent` → `DeepLinkParser` → `ShellActions.handle(link)`; while onboarding is incomplete the link parks in `PendingOpen` and drains on completion (iOS `pendingJukeboxLink` / `pendingOpenURL`). `launchMode="singleTask"` so a tapped link reuses the running shell.

**Jukebox guest** (JBX-2): `JoinedSessionsStore` (DataStore JSON `[{id,name,guestBase}]`, idempotent add-to-top, remove, updateName). `JukeboxJoinScreen` owns its poll (`LaunchedEffect` + 4 s loop, cancelled on leave), maps 404/410 → ended, highlights requests whose `clientId == installId`, "Tune In" plays `nowPlaying.streamUrl` via `PlaybackController.playUrl(title, artist, url, seekMs = positionMs + elapsed-since-updatedAt)` (new small method) and re-tunes when `title|artist` changes. Host tab (`JukeboxScreen`) shows `JoinedSessionsStrip` above create/live view; `pendingOpenId` from a tapped link routes `ShellRoute.JukeboxJoin(id)` through NavRequestBus.

**Settings** (SET-1/2): `SettingsSections.kt` exposes `fun settingsSections(graph): List<SettingsSection>`; `SettingsScreen` iterates it. New `AppSettings` keys (DataStore, additive-optional): `pocketDJName` (default ""), `defaultRecentlyAddedCount` (50, clamped 1…500), `ripFromCloud` (false), `onboardingMarkerJson`. Reset everything = clear settings DataStore (keeps nothing), `catalogService.clearCache()`, delete collections/history/activity/jukebox files, `onboarding.forcePending()`; the onboarding marker is written AFTER the wipe (iOS mushroom-cloud order). Backup zip mirrors `BackupZip.swift` entries (collections.json, sources.json, edits.json, favorites.json, manifest.json) via SAF `ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT`/`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT`; collections import under fresh ids via `CollectionsCodec` + id remap.

### Persistence formats
- Onboarding marker: JSON `{"version":1,"state":"pending|started|completed","stage":0..2,"completedAtMs":…}` — same as iOS `pdj.onboarding.v1`.
- Joined jukeboxes: JSON array `[{"id","name","guestBase"}]` — same as iOS `pdj.jukebox.joined.list.v1`.
- Widget snapshot: iOS `NowPlayingSnapshot` key set (above), file-backed; cover PNG beside it.
- Pending widget commands: `[{"kind","at","songId","scope","verdict"}]` (iOS `WidgetCommandChannel.Pending`).
- Backup zip: iOS `BackupZip` layout (read `apple/PocketDJ/Services/BackupZip.swift` for the exact entry names before implementing).
- All docs additive-optional, `PdjJson.lenient`, atomic temp-file+rename writes (existing store pattern).

### Threading
- `AppGraph.appScope` (Dispatchers.Default) for loops/observers; IO for disk/network; `MediaController`/`MediaSession` touches hop to Main (existing `withController` pattern). Glance `provideGlance` reads the snapshot file on IO. WorkManager `CoroutineWorker`s run on Default. The Auto callback must return quickly: `onGetChildren` reads already-loaded state and returns `Futures`; never awaits a network refresh. ProcessLifecycle `onStop` flush runs synchronously-ish via `runBlocking(IO)` bounded by 2 s so a quick suspend cannot lose the write.

### Mix DSP engine (touched by LOCK-1 only)
Shell constraint, not a DSP choice: whatever the Mix area picks (Oboe/AAudio native graph is the better fit for tempo/pitch/crossfade and is my recommendation if the decision falls to this stage), the engine must expose a Media3 `SimpleBasePlayer` facade implementing `TransportOwner`, so the one `MediaSession` can host it through `SessionPlayerArbiter.setOwner(mixPlayer)` and the lock screen / Auto / widgets drive the Mix with the iOS remote semantics (⏸ suspends the Auto-DJ, ▶ resumes, ⏭/⏮ = fast/slow switch, no ♥).
decisions: Keep the Android bottom-bar shell (Levi-approved at P1) but drive it from an adaptive NavigationSuiteScaffold: compact width = M3 NavigationBar with labels shown only for the selected item so a 7th destination (Games, placeholder until the Games area lands) fits; medium/expanded width = NavigationRail. Settings stays inside Browse (recorded Android product decision).
History becomes the default landing tab and the last-visited tab is restored on relaunch (iOS parity, Levi 2026-07-22); persisted in AppSettings as `lastSection` with the destination route token.

All out-of-UI entry points (Android Auto, widgets, shortcuts, Assistant media search, deep links) go through ONE façade `ShellActions` (the IntentServices analogue) and ONE route bus `NavRequestBus` with atomic-take + staged push; a route that cannot be honoured always produces a visible message.

Onboarding is ported with the iOS decision tree and marker shape; stage 1 is 'PocketDJ name + device-only' (iCloud branch N/A — no CloudKit; future S3 sync). The whole launch pipeline and every mutating ShellActions call wait on / are vetoed by onboarding, exactly as on iOS.

Background work uses WorkManager (periodic rip-reconcile 15 min with network constraint; storage-prune daily) and a ProcessLifecycleOwner ON_STOP flush funnel (`FlushRegistry`) replaces the iOS scenePhase .background flush block. No background URLSession analogue is needed in this area (transfers belong to the storage/burn area; the registry exposes a seam).

Lock-screen transport stays on the single Media3 MediaSession; a `SessionPlayerArbiter` swaps the session's Player between ExoPlayer and the future Mix `SimpleBasePlayer` facade with the iOS ownership rules (last-started owns; restored-never-sounded is not a remote target; preferred owner after restore). ♥ is a custom CommandButton shown only when the Collections area wires a FavoriteSeam; repeat/shuffle/next/prev commands are available only while a set runs.

Widgets are Glance AppWidgets fed by a file-backed snapshot that keeps the iOS NowPlayingSnapshot key names; transport taps are ACTION_MEDIA_BUTTON to the service (works with the process dead); ♥/repeat/shuffle taps queue in DataStore when the process is dead and drain on foreground (stale transport dropped, verdicts/favorites never). 👍/👎 stays hidden until recommendations exist on Android.

Android Auto = MediaLibraryService browse tree Playlists · Pockets (+ Continue row), with For You and the Mix tab deferred to their areas; Up Next edits remain phone-only (Auto renders the queue natively); no search tab in the tree (parity with the CarPlay removal) — Assistant voice covers hands-free. Browse-tree logic is pure Kotlin and unit-tested; the session callback is a thin adapter.

Siri/App Intents map to: MEDIA_PLAY_FROM_SEARCH + MediaSession search (Assistant), static + dynamic shortcuts (the donation analogue, debounced on collection changes, published through `pocketdj://play/...` links). Create Pocket (on-device Foundation Models) and the iOS 27 audio schema are N/A on Android.

Jukebox: host side is DONE; this program adds the guest/join surface, the deep-link join, the require-token default toggle, GET /sessions list+adopt client methods (for the future Auto Mix tab), and fixes the local played-history mirror to the server's dedup rule (pause→null and same-track rewinds are not transitions). Broadcast-into-Mix and Apple-Music-search matching are seams for the Mix / AM areas.

Settings gets a section registry so the Mix, For You, Recommendations and Apple-Music-sync areas append their rows without editing SettingsScreen.kt. Online-search controls remain deliberately absent until aoss lands. 'Reset everything' wipes everything local and forces onboarding `pending` AFTER the wipe (mushroom-cloud order). Settings credential sync is N/A (CloudKit).

Backup `.pocketdj.zip` and `.pdjcollection` import/export are implemented byte-shape-compatible with the iOS zips (read BackupZip/PocketZip/PlaylistZip.swift first) via SAF; `.pdjcollection` opens from Files/Messages through the deep-link intent filters.

Mix DSP substrate is NOT decided here; the shell imposes one constraint — the Mix engine must present a Media3 SimpleBasePlayer facade implementing `TransportOwner` — and recommends Oboe/AAudio if the Mix area has no stronger reason otherwise.

Multi-window (⌘N), tvOS/visionOS shells, APNs push, iCloud credential sync and keyboard shortcuts are recorded N/A with reasons; MwF deep links are parsed and parked so the Games area can consume them.
